intervals.label: ERC grant period: design and set-up of the experiment
intervals.note: Start is the grant start (1 Feb 2014); in the 2015 paper 'all the systems required for the HOLMES experiment are being designed and set-up'. The end is only an upper bound: the first physics results (two physics runs) were reported in March 2025 and the dates of those runs are not stated in the paper, so the construction/operation boundary is not sourced.
intervals.quote: The Italian Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare (INFN) is the Host Institution for the grant which started on February 1st 2014 and will end on January 31st 2019.

intervals.label: physics runs and first result
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv v1 date (2025-03-10) of the first physics result, which reports data from two physics runs lasting two months; the real start of data taking is earlier and undated in the paper. Open because no source says the experiment stopped; whether it is taking data on 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.
intervals.quote: With a total of 7 × 107 decay events recorded over two months and a Bayesian statistical analysis, we derive an upper limit of mβ < 27 eV/c2 at 90% credibility.

name: HOLMES TES microcalorimeter array with ion-implanted 163Ho

placements.note: Campus-grade site; the location of the cryostat used for the 2025 physics runs is not stated.
placements.quote: A cryogenic test-bed instrumented for TES arrays microwave readout is being set up at University of Milano-Bicocca laboratory.

energy_resolution.quote: achieving an average energy resolution of 6 eV FWHM with a scalable, multiplexed readout technique

isotope.quote: In this Letter, we present the most stringent upper bound on the effective electron neutrino mass ever obtained with a calorimetric measurement of the electron capture decay of 163 Ho.

sensor_count.note: Number of implanted detectors that showed activity in the 2025 runs; the design goal is about 1000 detectors.
sensor_count.quote: Following the implantation, 48 detectors were found to exhibit non-zero activity

temperature.quote: HOLMES uses arrays of Transition Edge Sensor (TES) microcalorimeters [33] operated at a temperature of about 95 mK in a 3 He/4 He dilution refrigerator.

summary.plain: A chip of tiny thermometers, each holding a few holmium-163 atoms in a gold absorber, cooled to a tenth of a degree above absolute zero so every decay heats it by a measurable amount.
summary.technical: Mo/Cu TES microcalorimeters on SiNx membranes with 163Ho implanted at about 100 Å depth in a 180×180 µm² gold layer, rf-SQUID microwave multiplexing; 48 active pixels in the 2025 runs.

technology.quote: HOLMES uses arrays of Transition Edge Sensor (TES) microcalorimeters [33] operated at a temperature of about 95 mK in a 3 He/4 He dilution refrigerator.
technology.value: Transition-edge-sensor microcalorimeters with 163Ho ion-implanted in a gold absorber, operated at about 95 mK in a dilution refrigerator with microwave-multiplexed readout
